# Outline templates (Diátaxis)

## Tutorial
1. Prerequisites (audience, env, prior knowledge)
2. Step-by-step numbered actions with expected output per step
3. Recap + next steps

## How-to Guide
1. Task heading ("How to <verb> ...")
2. Prerequisites
3. Steps (imperative, one action per step)
4. Expected outcome + troubleshooting

## Reference
1. Scope note
2. Alphabetical/hierarchical entries: signature/syntax → description → example → edge cases
3. Cross-links

## Explanation
1. Context / why this exists
2. What it is
3. Why it works / trade-offs
4. How it fits + related concepts
